title: Monday Club Night at Peak
description:
Cost:
• Adults: $17.50 for the whole month including rating, or $8 a night plus the rating fee
• Seniors (65+): $12.50 for the whole month including rating, or $6 a night plus the rating fee
• Under 18: the reduced rate, the rating fee only
Adult and senior monthly prices include the rating fee. Players under 18 pay only the rating fee: $0.50 per night, or $0.50 for each scheduled Monday in a whole-month registration. Paying by card adds 2.5% + $0.50.
Time control: G/60;+30 (60 minutes per player, with a 30-second increment on each move). Regular rated.

Weekly club night of the Larimer County Chess Club, Mondays from 6:30 PM until the last game ends, at Peak Community Church in Old Town Fort Collins. Players of every age and strength welcome. Just show up. Coffee and water are provided.

New to chess? Chess for Beginners, a free hour on the rules of chess, meets at 5:30 PM, the hour before club night.

Club games are US Chess events. A current US Chess membership is required. Join or renew at https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess#:~:text=Individual%20Membership%20Options

Players under 18 may come on their own. Parents remain responsible for them; the club doesn't supervise minors.

Questions: president@larimerchess.org

title: Larimer County Open Classic 90+30
description:
Cost: $16.50, the $15 entry plus $0.50 a round for US Chess rating. Players under 18 pay the reduced rate, $1.50. Paying by card adds 2.5% + $0.50. If the fee is a hardship, pay what you can; no US Chess member is turned away.
Time control: G/90;+30 (90 minutes per player, with a 30-second increment on each move). Regular rated.

A monthly US Chess rated tournament with a long time control, for players who want time to think. In Old Town Fort Collins.

Format: 3-round Swiss.

Public registration is limited to 50 players by default. The tournament director may adjust this limit or add players beyond it.

Round times
• Round 1: 10:00 AM
• Round 2: 2:30 PM
• Round 3: 7:00 PM

If a round runs long, the next one starts as soon as it finishes.

A current US Chess membership is required. Join or renew at https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess#:~:text=Individual%20Membership%20Options

Players of every strength welcome. Bring a board and clock if you have one. Clocks must support increment. Coffee and water are provided.

Players under 18 may come on their own. Parents remain responsible for them; the club doesn't supervise minors.

Meet on the main floor at Peak Community Church in Old Town Fort Collins.

Questions: president@larimerchess.org
